articles.origTitle: Restrictions In Paris To Remain In Place On Tuesday After Curfew Brings Calm

articles.title: Report Alleges Mistreatment Of North Koreans At Russian Plant
articles.summary: An investigation states that North Korean laborers face severe mistreatment while working at a Russian drone facility. The findings also express concern that Pyongyang's personnel might acquire practical expertise regarding advanced weaponry.
articles.origTitle: North Korean workers treated as 'slaves' at Russian drone factory, says new report
articles.origSummary: A new report reveals the plight of North Korean workers at a drone factory in Russia. It also raised concerns that Pyongyang could gain hands-on knowledge of advanced weapons systems through the workers it sends there.
